HyperLPR3 model release 20230229
Project: https://github.com/szad670401/HyperLPR
License: Apache License 2.0 (included as LICENSE.txt)

This distribution includes the unmodified y5fu_640x_sim.onnx and
rpv3_mdict_160_r3.onnx weights, renamed detector and recognizer in source.
The browser adapter uses the upstream detector preprocessing and token
vocabulary. It performs bilinear perspective sampling in TypeScript.
No OpenCV implementation is included.

Source archive: http://hyperlpr.tunm.top/raw/20230229.zip
Source code revision: 9307450f7b7915be18f23a539ec05b41fe6629f4
